children: Chow Tai Fook Jewellery's valuation seems appealing to Citi analysts, who note the stock appears to have priced in a potential decline in the jewelry company's 2H earnings. The Citi analysts estimate the stock's valuation at a 10X forward price-to-earnings ratio with a 7.0% yield. Chow Tai Fook's estimated 90%-100% net profit growth for 1H was above market estimates for an 80%-90% gain, the analysts say in a note. A drop in October sales also seems to be within management's expectations due to a high base, the analysts add. Citi places Chow Tai Fook at the top of its China gold jewelry sector pecking order. Citi retains its buy rating and target price of 15.40 Hong Kong dollars. Shares rise 2.2% to HK$10.71. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
